head.title: 1 Touch Barbershop · Barber Shop in Tallahassee, FL | 4.74 Rating, 1,538 Reviews
head.description: 1 Touch Barbershop in Tallahassee, FL: fades, beard lineups and kids cuts from a team of 8 barbers. 4.74 rating with 1,538 reviews on Booksy. Walk-ins welcome, book online.

script.es: El fade que buscas, cada vez.
script.en: The fade you're after, every time.

parrafo.es: Ocho barberos, un solo local en el corazon de Tallahassee. De fades de precision a contornos de barba y cortes para ninos, 1 Touch Barbershop se ha ganado su nombre corte a corte, respaldado por mas de 1,500 resenas en Booksy.
parrafo.en: Eight barbers, one shop in the heart of Tallahassee. From precision fades to beard lineups and kids cuts, 1 Touch Barbershop has built its name one cut at a time, backed by more than 1,500 reviews on Booksy.

hero.imagen_alt: Barber giving a client a precision fade at 1 Touch Barbershop, Tallahassee

parrafo_1.es: 1 Touch Barbershop es un equipo de ocho barberos en el centro de Tallahassee: Rony, McLovin, Daniel, PJay, Juvy, Tyler, Josean y Kevin. Cada uno con su propio estilo, todos con el mismo cuidado por el detalle en cada fade y cada contorno.
parrafo_1.en: 1 Touch Barbershop is a team of eight barbers in the heart of Tallahassee: Rony, McLovin, Daniel, PJay, Juvy, Tyler, Josean and Kevin. Each with their own style, all sharing the same attention to detail on every fade and every lineup.

parrafo_2.es: El trabajo habla solo: mas de 1,500 resenas en Google via Booksy y una calificacion de 4.74, ganada corte a corte, cliente a cliente, ano tras ano.
parrafo_2.en: The work speaks for itself: more than 1,500 reviews on Google via Booksy and a 4.74 rating, earned cut by cut, client by client, year after year.

texto.es: Reserva tu barbero en Booksy o simplemente pasa. Con ocho barberos en el local, la mayoria de los dias estas en la silla en minutos.
texto.en: Book your barber on Booksy or just walk in. With eight barbers on the floor, most days you are in the chair within minutes.

texto.es: Fade fresco, un contorno limpio o un lineup completo con barba: le dices a tu barbero lo que buscas y el te guia entre las opciones.
texto.en: A fresh fade, a clean edge-up, or a full lineup with beard: you tell your barber what you want and they walk you through the options.

texto.es: Maquina, lineas de precision y el nivel de detalle que le ha ganado a 1 Touch Barbershop mas de 1,500 resenas.
texto.en: Clippers, precision lines, and the kind of attention to detail that has earned 1 Touch Barbershop more than 1,500 reviews.

texto.es: Contorno final, toalla caliente y sales por la puerta con un corte impecable. Agenda tu proxima cita antes de irte.
texto.en: Edge-up, hot towel, and you are out the door looking sharp. Book your next cut before you leave.

nota.es: Precios exactos como se publican en Booksy. Reserva con el barbero de tu preferencia o pasa como walk-in.
nota.en: Exact prices as published on Booksy. Book with the barber of your choice or come by as a walk-in.

texto.es: Fade a piel o taper, mezclado a tu gusto por cualquier barbero del equipo.
texto.en: Skin fade or taper, blended to your preference by any barber on the team.

texto.es: El paquete completo: fade de precision y perfilado de barba en la misma visita.
texto.en: The full package: precision fade and beard shape-up in the same visit.

texto.es: Un corte limpio a tijera o maquina sin fade, para quienes prefieren algo simple y prolijo.
texto.en: A clean scissor or clipper cut without a fade, for guys who like it simple and sharp.

texto.es: Un contorno preciso entre cortes, listo en 15 minutos.
texto.en: A crisp edge-up between cuts, done in 15 minutes.

pie.es: Cada barbero tiene tambien sus propios cortes de firma (Rony G Cuts, McLovin's Fades, Juvy's Fades), ademas de combos con barba y corte para ninos desde $30. Menu completo y precios en Booksy.
pie.en: Each barber also has signature cuts of their own (Rony G Cuts, McLovin's Fades, Juvy's Fades), plus beard combos and a kids cut from $30. Full menu and pricing on Booksy.
